name: Disability services (NDIS)
what: Register with the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission for supports that require it, be audited, and ensure workers hold an NDIS worker screening clearance from the state.

basis.source: Health care and social assistance industry (industry information)
basis.quote: NDIS-registered businesses must follow the NDIS Act and rules .

issues.what: Providers working across disability, aged care and veterans' care register and are audited separately in each sector.

evidence.source: Delivering quality care more efficiently: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: Such an arrangement would reduce the time and costs associated with multiple registration processes

issues.what: Disability workers need separate screening checks for the NDIS, aged care and working with children.

evidence.source: Delivering quality care more efficiently: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: A single worker screening check will save care workers - 75% of whom are women - about $88 million a year. This includes the time value of approximately 419,000 hours a year that workers spend on duplicative paperwork.
